text:
maria: Heads-up — we need a 45m design review for the new API + SDK auth change + Console modal onboarding. Want to lock a time this week so we can get pre-reads out. Proposed slot windows: Tue 09:30-10:15 PT or Wed 10:00-10:45 PT. Can folks indicate availability and reviewer leads?

alex: I can do Tue morning but prefer Wed if we need a little more prep. Who's driving the API surface walkthrough?

maria: @alex you and @sanjay to cover API surface + migration risks. @katy will lead Console UX mock walkthrough. Oliver can do SDK auth/upgrade notes. I'll assemble a 1-pager pre-read tonight.

sanjay: ok. FYI the API changes are mostly additive: new query param `enable_delta` + stricter enum validation. Biggest risk is client libraries failing on 400s.

katy: re: Console modal — I have two variants (compact vs extended). Will add screenshots to the doc and a short click-through prototype. Requesting feedback on wording in the modal copy.

oliver: SDK: need to check our existing backwards compatibility tests. I'll run the compatibility matrix against the 2.1 branch tonight and attach results. If any tests fail we should postpone or scope down the rollout.

maria: Pre-read checklist (please ack when done):
```
- skim 1-pager (API surface + migration plan)
- try SDK quickstart (2 min) using `enable_experimental_wire=true`
- review Console modal screenshots + UX notes
- add blocking questions as comments in doc
```

alex: ack — I'll skim the 1-pager and run the quickstart. If I hit failures I'll post them under "blockers" section.

sanjay: ack. i can take Tue but prefer Wed if oliver needs extra time on SDK tests.

oliver: running tests now. ETA ~3 hours. If green, Wed works best for me.

katy: Wed works for me too. Will add copy alternatives to the doc by EOD.

maria: ok sounds like Wed 10:00-10:45 PT is the winner. @calendar-bot can you create the invite for Wed 10:00 PT, 45m, attach pre-read link and mark as video?

calendar-bot: Created event "Design review: API+SDK+Console" — Wed 10:00 PT, 45m. Invitees: maria, alex, sanjay, katy, oliver. Pre-read doc attached: https://docs.internal/redwood/designs/api-sdk-console-pre-read.

alex: :thumbsup: I'll be ready. Quick note — please add a short migration checklist in the doc so reviewers can approve rollback steps.

maria: good call. adding migration checklist now. If anything changes I'll ping here. Thanks all.

katy: thanks — will post the Console prototype link in the doc once uploaded.

sanjay: if we need a follow-up triage session after review, +1 for a 30m slot Thu afternoon.

maria: noted. I'll propose Thu 3:00 PT as fallback. Calendar invite set for Wed; folks add any blockers as comments in the pre-read."
